items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-21
items.q: when we were playing with Jack Carey's band... Jack Carey was on trombone, myself on drum

ctx.x: Punch Miller, yeah. Him and I is the one that originated then. See, because when we were playing with Jack Carey's band, him and I, we would study all kinds of foolishness. We'd go to bed with that, and we'd get in the barroom, and we'd speak about it. That's something that the other father didn't make. Yeah. And so one night, one night, we were sitting in a barroom called Fabolo, so 3rd and Franklin, coming from the National Park.
